name: Broadway Kids
description_short: A performing arts program for ages 5-10 (K to 5th grade) at the Marilyn Rodman Performing Arts Center in Foxborough. Children build performance skills through acting, singing and dancing, and every program ends with a performance for family and friends. No audition or experience is needed.

sources.note: Rechecked 2026-11-12. The page no longer shows the fall Holiday Dance Team; it now lists Broadway Kids 2027 dates, including a 3-week summer session August 2-20, 2027. Phone and ZIP from the site footer (administrative office).

source.title: Broadway Kids – Marilyn Rodman Performing Arts Center

warnings: This is not a summer camp. It is a fall/holiday after-school dance program: five Monday rehearsals (4:30-5:30 PM) plus a tech rehearsal and two shows.
Registration closed on October 1, 2026, and the first rehearsal was October 5, 2026. As of today (2026-10-13) this session is already running and probably can't be joined.
The page shows no future summer camp season. Nothing is listed for summer 2027.
Participants are expected to have some dance experience and must attend every rehearsal and both shows.
Family members need to buy tickets to see the shows.
